'''''Greigia''''' is a [[genus]] of plants in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Bromeliaceae]], subfamily [[Bromelioideae]]. It is native to [[Latin America]] from [[Mexico]] to [[Chile]].<ref name=d>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=247315 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref> The genus is named in honour of [[Samuel Greig|Major General Samuel Alexjewitsch Greig]], president of the Russian Horticultural Society in 1865.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://bsi.org/brom_info/genera.html |title=Bromeliad Info - Genera Etymology<!-- Bot generated title --> |access-date=2007-02-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070203011214/http://www.bsi.org/brom_info/genera.html |archive-date=2007-02-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>A. W. Smith {{google books|7ULDAgAAQBAJ|A Gardener's Handbook of Plant Names: Their Meanings and Origins|page=176}}</ref>

''Greigias'' are unique among bromeliads in that they do not die after flowering. Instead, they continue to bloom every year from the same rosette.<ref>V. Padilla ''Bromeliads'' (1977), pp.48 Crown Publishers, Inc {{ISBN|0-517-50045-0}}</ref>
